Real reform means tracking every dollar and cutting wasteful programs. Farmers need direct support, not more layers of bureaucracy. The solution isn't complex: streamline payments, eliminate redundant oversight, and put resources where they belong—supporting American agriculture.

Efficiency isn't partisan—it's the difference between farms thriving and families losing generations of work to red tape.
